Description: Infection of susceptible individuals through contact with infectious individuals.
Vaccination that fails to confer protection.
Progression from latent to infectious state.
Recovery from infection leading to immunity.
Infection of individuals with vaccine failure through contact with infectious individuals.

Name: Force of infection
Description: Age-specific per capita rate at which susceptible individuals (X and Xv) acquire infection. Values range from 0.0690 to 0.5167.

Name: Rate of progression from latency
Description: Rate of moving from the Latent (H) to Infectious (Y) compartment, corresponding to an average latent period of 7 days.

Name: Rate of recovery from infection
Description: Rate of recovery from the Infectious (Y) compartment, corresponding to an average infectious period of 7 days.

Name: Rate of loss of passive immunity
Description: Rate at which maternal immunity wanes. The table lists 40/year, while also noting an average duration of 3 months (which corresponds to a rate of 4/year).

Name: Vaccine efficacy
Description: The proportion (p) of vaccinated individuals who become immune.

Name: Birth rate
Description: Annual birth cohort in England and Wales.

Name: Background death rate
Description: Background death rate assumed for the residual age group (15-75 years).

Name: Contact rates
Description: Age-specific effective contact rates (beta values) defined in two alternative 'Who Acquires Infection From Whom' (WAIFW) matrices. Includes seasonal forcing for school-age children.
